description: Negative mutations applied to a deep copy of complete_metadata.json. The harness materializes the 12 JSON stems, sets checkpoint.json.stage to the requested stage, applies mutations, then runs the pinned validator in a fresh temp directory.

mutation_ops.delete_array_item: Delete one array item from files[file] where item[id_field] == id.
mutation_ops.delete_file: Remove files[file] from the materialized work directory.
mutation_ops.set: Set files[file] at the JSON path given by path[] to value.
mutation_ops.write_json: Write value as JSON to files[file] after the base fixture is materialized.
